what_it_does: Connects large language model (LLM) agents to high-performance computing (HPC) systems by integrating Parsl (a Python parallel programming library) into LangChain's tool calling mechanism. This enables LLM agents to submit and coordinate complex scientific simulations on HPC clusters like the Polaris supercomputer. The work demonstrates this capability by running molecular dynamics simulations, allowing AI assistants to orchestrate HPC workloads without manual job submission.
